title: Quiet Conflict Retention Envelope
purpose: Keep an unresolved learner-authored authority conflict returnable without converting retention, relevance, recency, or session carryover into permission to foreground it again.
rules: Retention keeps a canonical pointer to an unresolved conflict; it does not keep a winner, precedence, or resolution.
Quiet retained conflicts remain out of the foreground by default and create no pending notification.
Session start, recency, and inferred relevance cannot independently authorize resurfacing.
Machine-detected relevance may form a proposal but cannot itself authorize surfacing.
Foreground return requires an explicit learner request or an active learner-authored attention rule.
The learner may inspect, mute, or retire the retained conflict without expanding collection or scope.
Canonical pointers preserve provenance; source text is not duplicated into the retention envelope.
A source-rule or scope change triggers revalidation rather than silent reuse of the retained conflict.
